free_visa_notes: Vanuatu grants visa-free entry (free visitor permit, no application, no fee) to citizens of 117 countries per the official visa-exempted-countries list. All other nationalities require a paid tourist/visitor visa. No evidence found of nationality-based reciprocity fee variations (e.g. for IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN specifically) — these all appear to fall under either the exempt list or the standard non-exempt fee, but this was not independently confirmed against the exempt-country list contents. No VFS/TLScontact/BLS outsourced visa centre found; visas are processed directly by the Department of Immigration and Passport Services or via the official evisa.gov.vu portal. Direct WebFetch of immigration.gov.vu returned HTTP 403 (bot-blocked); all figures above come from search-engine cached extracts of the official pages and should be re-verified with a browser-based fetch or Firecrawl before being treated as final.
